metadata.goal: Read a pull request diff file and produce a code review report checking for null checks, error handling, and naming issues, with a read-only reviewer step to validate findings before writing the final output
metadata.platform_note: Tier 1d (Codex CLI): agents are TOML files with per-step model and model_reasoning_effort fields. dispatch_mechanism is model_driven. No Task() primitive. sandbox_mode controls reviewer isolation; reviewer.toml uses sandbox_mode = "read-only" for structural write-deny.

steps.description: Reads the pull request diff file, identifies issues (null checks, error handling, naming), writes structured findings JSON to the temp directory.
Reads analyzer findings, validates completeness and correctness, writes a verdict JSON to the temp directory. READ-ONLY: sandbox_mode = "read-only" enforces structural write-deny via Codex host.
Reads findings and verdict from temp directory, renders the final markdown code review report with issues and verdict sections, writes the output file.
